extraction_quality_notes: Ranking evidence was limited to initial presentation facts, HEMS assessment before treatment where separable, and initial ED metabolic/laboratory findings.
The article's title, abstract diagnostic wording, final interpretation, treatment response, and discussion-level causal framing were not used as ranking evidence.
No target-manifold field, paper-label field, paper conclusion field, or disease-specific observed axis was added.
Initial pCO2 and pO2 were excluded from ranking because they were measured after prehospital intubation and ventilation.
No ketone value, anion gap, chloride, respiratory rate, temperature, oxygen saturation, HbA1c, urine studies, cultures, or imaging findings are reported in the case text.
Several values required unit conversion for registry-compatible units: glucose mmol/L to mg/dL, hemoglobin mmol/L to g/dL, urea mmol/L to BUN mg/dL, and creatinine μmol/L to mg/dL.
The source says physical examination was otherwise unremarkable but provides few specific negative findings beyond no evidence of systemic infection.
